ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 80-85% high-intensity white pixels and 15-20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central and inner-lobe areas, bordered by a low-intensity black band along the trailing edge; discrete dark circular blobs are mapped at the mid-left lobe and near the lower central peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medium-to-high frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitude (2-12 pixels) along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge trailing from the lateral tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially concentrated, high-contrast dark pixel clusters observed at the distal lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark pigmentation spots scattered across the white ventral field and significant textured scarring at the extreme lateral lobe tips.
